content.class.porter.blurb: 你从船边把麻袋扛到磨坊。湿石头上穿靴子，爬坡时吃面包。
content.class.porter.kit.0.name: 搬运工靴子
content.class.porter.name: 搬运工
content.fx.the-tide-mill.oc.first-paddle.0.respa: 你回到第一段水道，已过第一道闸门。
content.fx.the-tide-mill.oc.second-paddle.0.resp: 你回到第二段水道，已过第二道闸门。
content.fx.the-tide-mill.oc.third-paddle.0.respa: 你回到最上段水道，已过最后一道闸门。
content.obj.the-tide-mill.first-paddle.hint: 第一道闸门升得很慢。先看它升起一次，再从它下面通过。
content.obj.the-tide-mill.first-paddle.title: 通过第一道闸门
content.obj.the-tide-mill.mill-yard.hint: 去磨坊院子的路在水道的最上端。
content.obj.the-tide-mill.mill-yard.title: 爬到磨坊院子
content.obj.the-tide-mill.second-paddle.hint: 第二道闸门保持升起的时间更短。等它开始升起再通过。
content.obj.the-tide-mill.second-paddle.title: 通过第二道闸门
content.obj.the-tide-mill.third-paddle.hint: 第三道闸门只升起一瞬。它一升起就立刻通过。
content.obj.the-tide-mill.third-paddle.title: 通过第三道闸门
content.quest.the-tide-mill.goal: 沿干涸的水道向上，穿过三道闸门到达磨坊院子，趁每道闸门升起时通过。
content.world.outro: 一行人爬出水道，进入磨坊院子。身后，三道闸门仍随着水轮的节奏起落，无人经过。
content.world.title: 潮汐磨坊

source.class.porter.blurb: You carry sacks up from the boats to the mill. Boots for the wet stones, and bread for the climb.
source.class.porter.kit.0.name: Porter's Boots
source.class.porter.name: Porter
source.fx.the-tide-mill.oc.first-paddle.0.respa: You come back in the first pound, past the first paddle.
source.fx.the-tide-mill.oc.second-paddle.0.resp: You come back in the second pound, past the second paddle.
source.fx.the-tide-mill.oc.third-paddle.0.respa: You come back in the head pound, past the last paddle.
source.obj.the-tide-mill.first-paddle.hint: The first paddle lifts slowly. Watch it rise once before you go under it.
source.obj.the-tide-mill.first-paddle.title: Pass the first paddle
source.obj.the-tide-mill.mill-yard.hint: The way up to the yard is at the head of the race.
source.obj.the-tide-mill.mill-yard.title: Climb to the mill yard
source.obj.the-tide-mill.second-paddle.hint: The second paddle stays up for less time. Wait for it to start rising.
source.obj.the-tide-mill.second-paddle.title: Pass the second paddle
source.obj.the-tide-mill.third-paddle.hint: The third paddle is up only for a moment. Go the instant it clears.
source.obj.the-tide-mill.third-paddle.title: Pass the third paddle
source.quest.the-tide-mill.goal: Go up the dry race through the three paddle gates to the mill yard, crossing each paddle while it is up.
source.world.outro: The party climbs out of the race into the mill yard. Behind them the three paddles keep rising and falling on the wheel's count, for nobody.
source.world.title: The Tide Mill
